name: NGT — Active Client Retention Sequence
description: Ongoing retention for paid clients. Monthly check-ins and exam season upsells.

emails.subject: How is your learner's progress going?
emails.body:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

It's been about a month since your learner started with NextGen Tutors, and we'd love to hear how things are going.

A few questions worth asking your learner this week:

  • Are they feeling more confident in the subject?
  • Have class test results improved?
  • Are they completing homework more independently?

If you'd like to increase session frequency or add a second subject, reply to this email and we'll arrange it within 24 hours.

The NextGen Tutors Team

emails.subject: Exam season is coming — is your learner ready?
emails.body:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

With mid-year exams approaching, many of our families are upgrading to our Intensive Exam Prep Package — 3 sessions per week for 4 weeks, focusing entirely on past papers, key concepts, and exam technique.

Benefits of the Intensive Package:

  • Structured 4-week programme aligned to CAPS exam guidelines
  • Past paper practise with tutor feedback
  • R300/hr rate (our best rate) with 12+ sessions commitment

Contact us to upgrade →
